text:
Predicates:
Timeless(x) ::: x is timeless.
DesignStyle(x, y) ::: x has design style y.
MassProductDesign(x) ::: x is a mass product design.
KellyWearstlerStyle(x) ::: x is a design style of Kelly Wearstler.
Evocative(x) ::: x is evocative.
Dreamy(x) ::: x is dreamy.
DesignBy(y, x) ::: y is a design by x.
MaxDesign(x) ::: x is a design by Max.

Premises:
∀x (DesignStyle(zahaHadid, x) → Timeless(x)) ::: All of Zaha Hadid's design styles are timeless.
¬∃x (DesignStyle(y, x) ∧ MassProductDesign(x)) ::: No mass product design is timeless.
DesignStyle(zahaHadid, y) ∨ KellyWearstlerStyle(zahaHadid) ::: Either Zaha Hadid's design style or Kelly Wearstler's design style.
∀x (KellyWearstlerStyle(x) → Evocative(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are evocative.
∀x (KellyWearstlerStyle(x) → Dreamy(x)) ::: All of Kelly Wearstler's design styles are dreamy.
∀x (Timeless(x) ∧ DesignBy(max, x) → (MassProductDesign(x) ∧ Evocative(x))) ::: If a design by Max is timeless, then it is a mass product design and evocative.

Conclusion:
Evocative(maxDesign) ∧ Dreamy(maxDesign) ::: A design by Max is evocative and dreamy.
